description: Two ledger writers still stamp created_at with datetime.now(UTC).isoformat(), which spells the offset as +00:00. The canonical ledger spelling is the Z form, and a row written with +00:00 next to rows written with Z sorts differently as text and is flagged by the ledger normalisation check.
goal: Make the interrupted-run summary row built in sandbox_executor/flow/partial_salvage.py and the superseding failure row built in sandbox_executor/entrypoint/sync_conflict.py stamp created_at with utc_now_z from sandbox_executor.ledger.order instead of datetime.now(UTC).isoformat(), removing any import that becomes unused. Row content other than created_at is unchanged. Code is self-explaining: no docstrings and no comments except '# why:' comments that record a reason the code cannot show.
rationale: Every ledger writer using one canonical stamp keeps the ledgers sorted and the normalisation check green without a later reorder.
acceptance_criteria: A test in apps/sandbox-executor/tests/test_partial_salvage.py builds the interrupted-run summary row with apps/sandbox-executor/src/sandbox_executor/flow/partial_salvage.py from a real prior execution row and asserts its created_at ends with Z, contains no +00:00, and is accepted by scripts/normalise_ledgers.py canonical_created_at unchanged.

A test in apps/sandbox-executor/tests/test_pre_push_sync_conflict.py builds a superseding_failure_row with apps/sandbox-executor/src/sandbox_executor/entrypoint/sync_conflict.py from a real base row and asserts its created_at ends with Z, contains no +00:00, and parses to an instant not earlier than the base row's created_at.
The existing tests in both files still pass, including the partial_head created_at comparison on resume.
All tests pass via 'uv run pytest' and 'uv run task lint' passes.
